blocks.text: Lake Titicaca and the Uros Islands – Lima

provenance.rationale: Extract the corresponding destination or service label from the verified Word paragraph.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit Lake Titicaca with an English-speaking guide. The tour lasts about 3 hours.

The lake lies at an altitude of almost 4,000 m. On its surface are the floating Uros Islands, built from reeds by the Aymara people.

Traditional activities continue here: fishing, weaving baskets and furniture, and building boats. Reeds underpin life on the islands: they form the islands' foundations, houses and boats. You can take a ride on the lake in a reed boat with a local resident.

The islands offer a glimpse of a community's everyday life on the water, rather than a museum reconstruction. Against Titicaca's almost motionless surface, the altitude and open space of the Andes feel especially striking.

After the tour, transfer to Juliaca airport with an English-speaking escort for your flight to Lima. Air tickets are not included in the price.

In Lima, an English-speaking guide will meet you and take you to your hotel.
